items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals (ankle). Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.implication: Ravens pass game takes hit; Huntley low ceiling.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews still viable but lower volume expected.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM then officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf. Projections updated.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday; Rams optimistic no setbacks.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; full role expected.
items.opportunity: High target share without Davante Adams.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then INACTIVE (quad) vs Dolphins after missing practice ramp.
items.why: Unlikely per sources; not full participant yet, early in recovery.
items.opportunity: Lead role and heavy snaps/carries for backup RB vs soft Miami run D.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT for MNF vs Cowboys (hamstring/ankle).
items.implication: Eagles WR corps depleted; avoid or pivot.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dallas Goedert and remaining WRs; Saquon if active.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected lead and produced 124/17/1 but Levitan thinks he is actually hurt (hamstring) though not certain.
items.why: Post-game assessment; hamstring noted in watch list.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 8; handcuff/Tracy elevated if limited.
items.opportunity: If limited, Tyrone Tracy (also hamstring watch) or others.
items.conflict: Rapoport pregame expected full lead role.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if truly injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no lasting concern indicated.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys (hamstring).
items.why: In line to return for MNF home game.
items.implication: Strong start/RB2+ in great matchup if active.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated and listed IN/expected to play vs Lions after exempt list.
items.implication: Potential RB2 but rust/workload questions post-layoff.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (quad) went to locker room but returned to game; rarely buys RB-as-WR hype but tempted given 49ers WR injuries and Kaelon Black.
items.why: Quad issue mid-game but came back; smile on slot comments.
items.implication: Monitor but no major downgrade; possible expanded routes.
items.opportunity: Potential more slot/WR snaps amid WR injuries.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage and matchup (WR10); Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Back in real role; elite volume potential vs soft Bears.
items.opportunity: High target share in PHI pass game (pre Smith/Wicks outs).

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6); Lions D is fantasy buffet for opposing pass catchers.
items.why: Matchup juice vs Lions pass D.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12) for workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Big workloads vs defenses carved up by RBs; Hubbard consistency.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) post-layoff workload questions and Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37) brutal spot.
items.why: Jacobs rust after long absence; Skattebo tough matchup/role risk.
items.conflict: Jacobs activated/IN; Skattebo produced as lead.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow), Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D).
items.implication: Sit/fade in favor of better spots.
